description: Two stimuli colocated in RF, contrasts covary; attend preferred vs attend nonpreferred (response-gain-like). Attend-preferred (upper solid) saturates at ~0.68 of left-axis full scale; attend-nonpreferred (lower solid) saturates at ~0.50 -- a sustained vertical separation, neither reaching 1.0. Dashed percent-modulation (right axis 0-100) starts ~54% at low contrast and declines monotonically to ~36% at high contrast, staying WELL within 0-100 in the paper. (Implementation's %-modulation overshoots past 100 -- intended failing test -- but this is the PAPER curve.)

provenance.figure_type: line/curve CRF pair + dashed %-modulation, log-x, twin right axis
provenance.tool_rationale: Mode-1 plot: two same-colour solid CRFs that converge at low contrast and a dashed %-mod that crosses both. detect_plot_box gave a hint; the bottom frame had to be re-anchored by hand (see caveats). Per-column dark-cluster scan + right-to-left nearest-neighbour continuity tracking separated the three curves; crop_region zooms verified the crossing; PCHIP renders the overlay.

per_curve.attend_pref: traced via per-column darkest-cluster centroid + continuity; smooth monotone sigmoid, plateau ~0.682. Clean through the crossing (dashed crosses it near x~0.07 but did not contaminate the band).
per_curve.attend_nonpref: traced via continuity; the darkest-band picked up the descending dashed %-mod line where it crosses near x=0.104-0.107 (spurious spike to 0.43 then dip), producing the reported non-monotone wiggle. Bridged those two contaminated points by monotone log-interpolation between the clean reads at x=0.10 (0.399) and x=0.111 (0.418); result is smooth monotone-rising, plateau ~0.50.
per_curve.percent_modulation: dashed curve, isolated by being the only curve above both solids at low-x and the lowest at high-x; sparse (dashed gaps). Re-read smooth monotone-declining 53.5%->36%. The previous reference dipped to 38.3% at x=0.087 (a wiggle where the dashed passes between the solids) -- removed; the true dashed declines smoothly through the crossing.

provenance.normalization: paper shared sub-1.0 left scale; attend_pref plateau ~0.682, attend_nonpref ~0.50, NOT pinned to 1.0. Right axis 0-100; dashed stays within [0,100] (paper).
caveats: Plot box bottom frame is row 165, NOT the detect_plot_box/dark-row candidate row 207 -- row 206-207 is the SEPARATE 'Stimuli' legend box below panel E. Left axis (col 50) runs continuously 11..165 then a gap, confirming y=0 at row 165. Calibration re-anchored accordingly; matches the shipped overlay frame.
No numeric x ticks on this panel -- x_range [0.01,1.0] taken from the model sweep / panel role (panel_E.md).

Dashed %-mod is sparse; its values in the crossing gap (x~0.06-0.10, hidden between the two solids) are interpolated, not directly traced -- flagged as a smooth bridge consistent with the isolated reads on both sides.

corrections_this_pass.reason: Reviewer flagged weird movements near the curve intersection in overlay_4E.png.
